recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If modifier declarations are wanted again in core SearchParameter downloads, revisit FHIR-20470 or create a new work-group decision rather than treating FHIR-13864 as still requiring a source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-13864 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core SearchParameter correction for STU3 reporting that build.fhir.org/search-parameters.xml and the equivalent JSON download were out of date because generated SearchParameter instances did not include comparator or modifier elements.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to SVN revision 14532. In Git, f25a484e20387684e12152c5625b387c453dd71f is the corresponding GF#13864 commit; it changed search-parameter generation to add comparator/modifier declarations and updated the SearchParameter model/source spreadsheet.
additional_context: SearchParameter remains active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition still defines SearchParameter.comparator and SearchParameter.modifier. FHIR-20470 was later Published/Persuasive and removed generated AND/OR and modifier declarations from core SearchParameter instances so IGs and capability statements could constrain support without inheriting all potential modifiers. The current build download contains generated comparator declarations and no modifier declarations, matching that later context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current generated output includes comparator data, and modifier data is intentionally absent after FHIR-20470 rather than missing due to an unapplied FHIR-13864 requirement.
